test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

“You look so young! / When did you completed your graduation?” / asked Rekha / to her neighbour.

options.text: When did you completed your graduation?

solution:
The **correct answer** is **Option 2) ***"When did you completed your graduation?"*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this segment lies in the use of the verb form "**completed**" after the auxiliary "**did**." 
 
• The **correct phrasing** should be "When did you complete your graduation?" This maintains the proper verb tense and structure for a question in English.
 
• The use of "**did**" automatically indicates the past tense, thus there's no need to use the past tense form of the verb that follows; instead, the base form is used.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) **"to her neighbour" correctly identifies whom Rekha is speaking to.
 
• **Option 3)** "asked Rekha" is a correct narrative tag indicating who is speaking.
 
• **Option 4) **"You look so young!" is a correct exclamatory sentence expressing surprise or admiration.
